column1: # Any-Chart Reports Lab: what the module ships, and which country / charts each file suits.
# Used to suggest a rule set and layouts from the company country (Setup > Company) and the active chart.
# kind: nature (rule file in seed/) or layout (file in seed/layouts/). charts: chart codes separated by |
# country: only for countries with a national standard numbering (e.g. France's PCG), so a file is never
# suggested by country for a custom chart whose numbers mean something else (e.g. Australia, US).
